verdict.rationale: The repo says its skills are independently versioned (docs-19, docs-20). The `yy` CLI selects the 'latest compatible stable release' (gh-6), and validation checks plugin version parity and retired lifecycle instructions (gh-7). Legacy copies are preserved and flagged rather than silently deleted (docs-3). This shows versioning and some hints of retirement handling, but no written deprecation policy. missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy (timelines, notice periods, support windows), versioning/semver guarantees for skill invocation contracts or CLI interfaces, changelog or migration docs, independent corroboration.
